en-US: Create polished shareable note images on Web, Android, and iOS with PNG/JPEG export, eight poster themes, typography controls, and brand styling.
Link notes quickly with @ suggestions and open referenced notes directly from the editor.
Insert the current date or time through new editor slash commands.
Preserve edits more reliably when reconciling synchronized memo placeholders.
Make official Docker releases consistently available from both GHCR and Tencent TCR for smoother self-hosted deployments.
zh-CN: 在 Web、Android 和 iOS 上生成精美的笔记分享图片，支持 PNG/JPEG 导出、8 款海报主题、排版调节与品牌样式。
通过 @ 建议快速链接笔记，并可直接从编辑器打开引用的笔记。
通过新增的编辑器斜杠命令插入当前日期或时间。
在协调同步笔记占位记录时更可靠地保留编辑内容。
让官方 Docker Release 稳定发布到 GHCR 与腾讯云 TCR，改善自托管部署体验。
